notes_for_editor: One firelookout.ca record is the only tower-specific source; its 1977 and 1963 map entries are reported as the record states them, and the maps were not opened. The record's 459 m is ground elevation, not structure height, so no height_m is recorded. No source gives a build year, status, access or current condition, so no events or visit facts are recorded. The Wikipedia article on the community of Shining Tree was read, has no fire-tower content, and is not cited. The Ontario-wide context comes from a volunteer history site and a Sudbury News feature, not from Sudbury District records. The record's photo credit ('Courtesy of Clayton Self') is not used because the story has no photo.
